import json, os, sys
data = json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())

fd = os.memfd_create("atrium-harness-config", 0)
os.write(fd, json.dumps(data["config"]).encode())
os.execv("/app/docker/prod_entrypoint.sh", [
    "docker/prod_entrypoint.sh", "--config", "/proc/self/fd/" + str(fd),
    "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "4000", "--num_workers", "1",
])

import base64,contextlib,io,json,logging,os,pathlib,sys,traceback,zipfile
root=pathlib.Path("/run/atrium-publication-models")
data=json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())
os.environ.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",TMPDIR=str(root))
for name,body in data.pop("archives").items():
 with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(body))) as archive: archive.extractall(root/name)
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/"python"),str(root/"project"),str(root/"project/tests/atrium_n04")]
os.chdir(root)
logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
try:
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()),contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
  from publication_models import run
  result=run(data)
except Exception as error:
 frame=traceback.extract_tb(error.__traceback__)[-1]
 result={"status":"failed","code":getattr(error,"code",type(error).__name__),
         "location":pathlib.Path(frame.filename).name+":"+str(frame.lineno)}
print(json.dumps(result))
raise SystemExit(0 if result["status"]=="passed" else 1)
